assign.outcome: **Round 2 landed: 31 new entries (71 total), 20 new sources (55 total), 3 new pages + 3 enriched.** Recency-signature thread traced 3 more invented traditions alongside Blue Star Kachina -- Dogon Sirius mystery (Van Beek 1991 found no Dogon knowledge of Sirius B; informants said they learned it from Griaule), the Emerald Tablets of Thoth (claimed 1925, published 1940s, copies Lovecraft near-verbatim), and the Kolbrin Bible (claimed 1184 Glastonbury rescue, actual paper trail starts 1992). Wandjina ethnography (Crawford, Mowaljarlai) shows the real live controversy is internal -- who may repaint, not aliens. Honest hunt for a genuinely-thin depiction found one: the Nazca Astronaut/Owl Man figure has no scholarly consensus (shaman/deity/fisherman all argued), unlike the rest of Nazca. Cross-cultural sky-being iconography traced to two converging mainstream frameworks: convergent solar-halo symbolism and the Lewis-Williams/Dowson entoptic (trance-neurology) model, itself genuinely contested (Bahn and Helvenston). Credence movement: Nazca reframed from largely-settled to settled-except-one-figure; Wandjina gains a real internal controversy alongside the settled outsider-projection verdict.
